scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Monday's Hilo tidepool outreach transfer and aquarium setup reliable while using the booked early HNL-to-ITO itinerary.
Emerging Need: A general screening advisory is not enough to change plans, but the later switch to a sealed wet-demo cooler makes the ordinary airport timing plausibly unsafe.
Decision Context: The useful window depends on stored cooler pre-check rules plus the active flight confirmation, because the notices do not identify whether the low-commitment review list is warranted.
Consequence: Advance specialist-review listing can no longer be added. Walk-up screening remains possible with uncertain delay, and earlier airport arrival or other feasible arrangements may still protect the itinerary.

parameter.title: Hilo tidepool outreach classroom setup
parameter.description: Hands-on salinity station at Hilo aquarium classroom; current materials are regular slides and dry reef props.

parameter.subject: Monday HNL interisland screening staffing advisory
parameter.body: For Monday departures before 09:00, HNL interisland screening points will run with reduced specialist staffing. Ordinary carry-ons should follow normal arrival guidance. Unusual wet or oversized demonstration containers may encounter longer screening, and the carrier will accept specialist-review list clearances when presented at bag check.

parameter.description: Prepaid ITO airport-to-Hilo aquarium shared shuttle for 08:35 pickup after the early HNL-ITO arrival.

parameter.content: Monday's touch-tank team switched the classroom segment to the live comparison format. Please bring the sealed 8-gallon tidepool-water cooler, about 24 x 15 x 14 inches, instead of the dry reef props; room access is still 09:15.

parameter.subject: HNL specialist review queue closes at 17:00 today
parameter.body: The HNL Agriculture Inspection Desk will export Monday morning's interisland specialist-review list at 17:00 HST today. A small number of review slots remain for travelers carrying demonstration coolers or sealed sample containers.

parameter.subject: Monday interisland specialist review list exported
parameter.body: The specialist-review list for Monday morning HNL interisland departures has been exported to the checkpoint and carrier desks. New demonstration-cooler entries can no longer be added for those departures; travelers not listed should use standard walk-up inspection.
